body: Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me. In this example, directional shadow filter quality is set to Soft Ultra and positional shadow filter quality is set to Hard: Forward+ | Mobile (`master`) | Mobile (this PR) -|-|- | | @clayjohn The offsets appear correct, see [this code](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c016f22009aa773f0b2e6fce72baec168746491f/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_mobile/scene_shader_forward_mobile.h#L88-L116) I annotated for reference: ```cpp struct { uint32_t use_light_projector : 1; // Offset 0, size 1 uint32_t use_light_soft_shadows : 1; // Offset 1, size 1 uint32_t use_directional_soft_shadows : 1; // Offset 2, size 1 uint32_t decal_use_mipmaps : 1; // Offset 3, size 1 uint32_t projector_use_mipmaps : 1; // Offset 4, size 1 uint32_t disable_fog : 1; // Offset 5, size 1 uint32_t use_depth_fog : 1; // Offset 6, size 1 uint32_t use_fog_aerial_perspective : 1; // Offset 7, size 1 uint32_t use_fog_sun_scatter : 1; // Offset 8, size 1 uint32_t use_fog_height_density : 1; // Offset 9, size 1 uint32_t use_lightmap_bicubic_filter : 1; // Offset 10, size 1 uint32_t use_material_debanding : 1; // Offset 11, size 1 uint32_t multimesh : 1; // Offset 12, size 1 uint32_t multimesh_format_2d : 1; // Offset 13, size 1 uint32_t multimesh_has_color : 1; // Offset 14, size 1 uint32_t multimesh_has_custom_data : 1; // Offset 15, size 1 uint32_t scene_use_ambient_cubemap : 1; // Offset 16, size 1 uint32_t scene_use_reflection_color : 1; // Offset 17, size 1 uint32_t scene_use_reflection_cubemap : 1; // Offset 18, size 1 uint32_t scene_roughness_limiter_enabled : 1; // Offset 19, size 1 uint32_t soft_shadow_samples : 6; // Offset 20, size 6 uint32_t penumbra_shadow_samples : 6; // Offset 26, size 6 }; ``` Other bits in `scene_shader_forward_mobile.glsl` are correct, there doesn't appear to be any accidentally reused bits. This was likely a rebase issue.
